mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in the last two months indicates a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth and thus positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in the previous two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in the last month signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, thereby positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3pp in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last two months signals a strengthening supply side, which is indicative of robust economic activity and thus positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the previous two months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods with high RSAFS levels.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in the last month indicates a robust labor market, which boosts economic activity and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp and PAYEMS increase > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in the last month signals a disinflationary environment with easing monetary policy, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decrease and CPIAUCSL decrease > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a significant increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% in the last quarter, during a period of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4%), signals strong economic fundamentals, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 2% in 1 quarter and UNRATE < 4%
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.
